$source.h2: v4b's line. The sandbox is reclaimed once idle (docs/prd/session-lifecycle.md L8); the Session has no inactivity deadline (SPEC §4 L60) and continues after the sandbox was reclaimed (SPEC §4 L53).
$source.sub: A turn succeeds only when a checkpoint of its workspace and native conversation commits with it, and failed or cancelled turns never replace the last one (SPEC §4 L46, L49); the next input restores it, on a fresh sandbox once the old one was reclaimed (session-lifecycle.md L8).
$source.cards: Harness: four (README L9), frozen for the Session (SPEC §3 L31). Model key: bring your own (SPEC §2 L25), never enters the sandbox (SPEC §5 L65). Sandbox: one per Session (SPEC §3 L32), full access inside (SPEC §5 L65). Files: what the Agent writes under outputs/ becomes downloadable artifacts (session-files.md L9). Resume: the Thread ID is the one handle (SPEC §4 L38); one minute or seven days later, same semantics (SPEC §4 L53).

en.sub: Every successful turn ends in a checkpoint. The next turn resumes from there.

cards.label: Harness
cards.line: One of four, fixed for the whole Session.

cards.label: Model key
cards.line: Your provider key, kept outside the sandbox.
